# Fine Time for Cathy's Clean Green Classics

> Fresh custom salads, healthy meals, and cold-pressed juices prepared in Trinidad & Tobago. Order online for delivery or pickup.

## Pages

- [/](/): Homepage — browse salads, meals, and juices.
- [/salads](/salads): Custom salads with your choice of protein and toppings.
- [/meals](/meals): Hearty, homestyle healthy meals.
- [/juices](/juices): Cold-pressed juices and wellness shots.
- [/gallery](/gallery): Food photography and behind-the-scenes shots.
- [/faq](/faq): Ordering, delivery, pickup, and pricing questions.
- [/contact](/contact): Reach out via form, WhatsApp, phone, or email.

## Ordering

Delivery days: Monday, Wednesday and Friday. Same-day orders close at 8 AM Trinidad time. Delivery 11 AM to about 2 PM. Pickup: Trincity 2 PM to 5 PM or St. Clair 11 AM to 1 PM. Book up to six months ahead; select the date before adding meals.
Healthy meals alternate weekly between Menu A (Quinoa Chow Mein, Sweet Potato Basil, Cumin Basmati, Roasted Vegetable Medley) and Menu B (Zesty Herb Bowl, Mediterranean Mex Bowl, Moroccan Spiced Chicken & Couscous Bowl). Menu A is anchored 19 October 2026. The home menu switches every Friday at 8 AM.
Vegetarian options exclude meat and seafood but may contain dairy and egg. Salads and juices do not rotate.
